strings: r_c0 sits with m_c well into the night while {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stare/stares} listlessly and somewhat forlornly at {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws and the bedding of the nest around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
m_c really wishes that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could just sleep as the dawn rises up around {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with yet another sleepless night fading away.
Some of m_c's denmates are getting really annoyed by {PRONOUN/m_c/object} getting up and disturbing everyone else when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/wander/wanders} off.
While it's good for m_c to keep busy at night, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} denmates worry as they see {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} fur getting messier and messier from lack of energy to care.
